# ANSEM Analytics

> A live, read-only analytics dashboard for the Solana token $ANSEM
> (mint 9cRCn9rGT8V2imeM2BaKs13yhMEais3ruM3rPvTGpump). Price, order flow,
> trade depth, holder distribution and contract safety, refreshed
> continuously and free to read.

Everything published here is measured. Nothing is forecast, scored or rated.
Where a figure could not be measured it is reported as unknown rather than
estimated, and where a data source is partial the page says so and states the
coverage it actually reached.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://ansemherd.online/dashboard): Live price, market pulse,
  trading rhythm, order flow by wallet, trade depth at size, risk profile,
  contract safety, holder rankings and supply distribution.
- [Documentation](https://ansemherd.online/dashboard/docs): How to read each
  panel, a glossary of the terms used, and the point at which each figure
  stops being reliable.
- [About](https://ansemherd.online/dashboard/about): What the dashboard
  tracks and why each panel is measured the way it is.
- [API](https://ansemherd.online/dashboard/api): Free read-only JSON
  endpoints, no key required, CORS enabled.
- [Campaign](https://ansemherd.online/): The Black Bull Herd Card NFT
  campaign, which closed on 17 August 2026.

## API

- `GET /api/dashboard/snapshot`: Everything on the dashboard in one payload.
- `GET /api/dashboard/chart?range=1h|24h|7d|30d|all`: OHLCV candles.
- `GET /api/dashboard/trades`: Recent swaps above $250.
- `GET /api/dashboard/holders?page=1&pageSize=50`: Ranked holder list.
- `GET /api/dashboard/rank/{wallet}`: One wallet's position among all holders.

## Data sources

DexScreener for price, liquidity and 24h trade counts; GeckoTerminal for
candles and the trade tape; Jupiter for executable slippage quotes; CoinGecko
for rank and all-time high/low; Solana mainnet for supply and mint
authorities; Helius DAS for the holder index.

## Notes

This is a community project. It is not affiliated with the $ANSEM team and
nothing on it is financial advice.
